name: P-013 live resume matrix: all six claude/codex/omp cross-backend psu --resume pairs deliver a session port on staging, and PUI-shape resumes reopen the original backend
command: psu --resume <source adv id> --agent <target backend>  (canonical launcher apps/operator/scripts/psu-launcher.mjs via PAPERCUSP_PSU_LAUNCHER, PAPERCUSP_OPERATOR_URL=staging :3170, one ordered pair at a time)
psu --resume <adv id>  (PUI ended-session pane argv, no --agent, once per backend)
summary: On staging :3170 (build 3e8525d881), one tracked source session per backend (claude adv 42034, omp adv 42036, codex adv 42045) was resumed onto each other backend with psu --resume --agent. All six ordered pairs reached harness_shared.session_ports status=delivered, re-read live from the database at about 2026-10-13T03:22Z: claude->omp 71dc94c9 (02:58:17Z), claude->codex 28e089f7 (02:57:45Z), omp->codex 33b0b29b (03:01:23Z), omp->claude 4d15634c (03:03:24Z), codex->claude 0898982e (03:07:23Z), codex->omp 28d4b61f (03:10:21Z). Each launch printed 'session port delivered - verified the exact seed checksum in the target native transcript' from the production native-transcript reader, and the session-port seed ('port-id: <id>') is present in each target's indexed native transcript. The PUI ended-session argv psu --resume <adv id> (no --agent) reopened the ORIGINAL backend on the same native conversation for claude, omp and codex. Full per-pair detail: docs/evidence/cbp-p013-live-resume-matrix-2026-10-13.json (sha256 c5800856fc0f28b6abfe08e78767b57db834c6635302cd5c76ac40f9f8e3f0e0).

disclosures: Staging only. Production :3070 serves main d740fc3802, which does not carry these launcher fixes, and the ~/.local/bin/psu shim resolves the release launcher unless PAPERCUSP_PSU_LAUNCHER is set. An owner's bare `psu --resume` gets this behaviour once green main carries it.
The source sessions were seeded before startedAt, which marks the first session-port preparation.

One attempt failed and is excluded: omp->claude port 1a0587f1-667f-4c31-a04e-3a8f3c1d0a57 ('managed pty unavailable before session-port seed delivery'). Two concurrent resumes of one source share its coord identity, so the pty-host single-continuation guard refused the second. Re-run sequentially, the pair delivered as 4d15634c. This is not one of the four measured causes in R-24. The identity-sharing behaviour is filed as EI-25832331831534474.
The first codex source attempt (adv 42037, gpt-6.1-sol:low) showed only spinner output for more than 300s and was stopped. The xhigh retry (adv 42045) was used. This was not diagnosed further.
codex->omp delivered at summary-tail fidelity, because the omp target's token budget was smaller than the codex source transcript.
